name: Concrete CMS
description: Concrete CMS is an open-source content management system with in-context editing and structured site management. It supports pages, areas, blocks, files, users, groups, permissions, workflows, Express data objects, themes, packages, and a core REST API.
agentUseSummary: Relay reads only the page ID and date-added and last-updated timestamps for one preselected Concrete CMS page through a fixed core REST API GET. The upstream endpoint can return content and identity-bearing page fields, so Relay explicitly discards every field outside that lifecycle projection before returning data.

credentialRequirements.name: CONCRETE_CMS_SITE_BASE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Concrete CMS HTTPS site base URL

capabilities.label: Read selected page lifecycle
capabilities.description: Read one selected page's ID and lifecycle timestamps.

allowed.label: Read selected page lifecycle
allowed.description: Use one fixed core REST API individual-page GET and return only its lifecycle projection.

blocked.label: Expose content or private site data
blocked.description: Page names, descriptions, paths, content, blocks, areas, versions, users, permissions, attributes, files, links, and every non-lifecycle field are excluded from Relay output.

blocked.label: Mutate Concrete CMS
blocked.description: Pages, versions, blocks, files, users, groups, permissions, Express objects, configuration, packages, and every POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, upload, or other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Concrete CMS access
blocked.description: Page collections, other page IDs, content resources, users, groups, files, Express data, arbitrary routes or queries, redirects, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Selected Page Lifecycle Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected page's lifecycle projection; content, identities, other resources, administration, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Mount one no-input selected-page lifecycle reader backed by Railway's bounded Concrete CMS adapter.
Mount one no-input selected-page lifecycle reader backed by Railway's bounded Concrete CMS adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized public HTTPS Concrete CMS 9.2+ staging site must provide a dedicated access token with exactly pages:read, one selected numeric page ID, and Fairfax validation.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console lane, configure the least-privilege staging token, enter the site URL and selected page ID through Relay, then validate exact-resource binding, output redaction, redirect and private-DNS denial, insufficient-scope denial, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Official Concrete CMS documentation states that versions 9.2 and later include a REST API with OAuth2 and OpenID Connect authentication.
Official endpoint documentation defines GET /ccm/api/1.0/pages/{pageID} for one specific page and shows that the response includes lifecycle fields alongside richer page data.
Official scope documentation defines pages:read as the read scope for page endpoints, allowing Relay to require exactly that scope for the dedicated token.
Official 9.2.0 release notes identify the built-in REST API and OAuth2/OpenID Connect server as core additions.
